answer: An AI-agent economy can deter Sybil attacks via identity-salted Proof-of-Space-Time. Each agent stores a unique, incompressible dataset keyed to its address and answers random Merkle audits paced by a verifiable delay function within strict timeouts. Because plots cannot be shared across keys or recomputed in time, attackers incur dedicated storage and read I/O per fake identity. Yet large drive demands exclude lean edge bots monitoring a cliff ledge, lotus pond, or pearl farm.
